prompt:
Pixel-art sprite sheet for a horizontal arcade shoot-'em-up: ONE armour wing of the HALCYON BULWARK boss — upper wing, a long armoured plate carrying a laser emitter.

Design identity to keep exactly — a long, flat armoured airfoil wing plate about four times as wide as it is tall: a bold steel-blue band (#2e5082 body, #4a78b0 face, #8ab8e8 lit edge) with a deep blue #1e3458 shadow edge along one long side, a single cyan sensor light (#38d8f8) near the thick inner (right) end, and two or three small amber warning stripes (#e8c048) on the outer third, 1-px near-black outline (#0a1428). The plate is SOLID and chunky: its height is a full quarter of its length (about 4:1 — never a 5.5:1 sliver, hairline wire, thin blade or tapered needle), yet it stays a SMALL horizontal chip of roughly 380 px long by 95 px thick floating dead-centre in the 512×256 frame (huge empty green bands above and below it) — most of the frame is EMPTY flat green and the background must dominate; a wing spanning edge to edge ruins the sheet.

Rebuild it as a sprite sheet under this strict contract:
- On a CONTINUOUS flat pure bright green chroma-key background, exactly hex #51e018, identical solid colour in every background pixel: no gradient, no vignette, no shadow, no floor plane, no panel, no second green shade.
- EXACTLY 1 cell = the whole 512×256 canvas, holding exactly ONE wing — nothing else.
- The subject (one wing): the UPPER wing: horizontal, its flat dark shadow edge along the BOTTOM, its top edge stepping down in a long shallow diagonal toward a blunt outer tip on the LEFT, blunt mounting end on the RIGHT. The subject lies within aspect 2.90:1 to 5.40:1.
- CENTRING AND SIZE: the wing lies at the exact centre of the canvas, at most 430 px long and 75-115 px thick, centred VERTICALLY with at least 70 px of unbroken flat #51e018 above and below it, and at least 30 px clear to each canvas side.
- NO guide lines, NO borders, NO frames, NO text, NO labels, NO numbers — the description above is ordering instruction only, never drawn.
- Style: the finest retro pixel art for its native resolution — as much detail as possible at that low resolution (rivets, panel seams, lit edge ramp), crisp hard-edged square pixels, chunky bold forms, four-to-six step shading lit from the top-left, clean saturated colours, 1-px near-black outline on every silhouette edge, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no smooth gradients.
negative: photorealistic, 3d render, text, letters, labels, numbers, cell borders, guide lines, grid lines, watermark, signature, blurry, anti-aliasing, smooth gradient background, scenery, stars, cast shadow, drop shadow, multiple subjects per cell, empty cell, cropped subject, subject touching edge
